architecture.mirror_physical: m independent FP64 scalars plus explicitly serialized int16 sparse addresses
architecture.mirror_transform: deterministic Householder+Givens+permutation; inverse; residual tanh; same code shared across all worlds
architecture.shared_seed_transform: 4 fixed orthogonal stages independent of K and R

data.dataset: sklearn.load_digits 1797 labeled 8x8 digits; no external download
data.split: world-stratified 20% test, of remainder 20% dev; train remaining 64%

training.native: torch AdamW lr=0.008, 900 updates, batch=128, FP64, one CPU thread, dev accuracy must be >=0.90
training.compile: analytic nonlinear inverse then teacher-coordinate top-|value| sparse selection followed by weight-MSE LBFGS maximum 75 iterations; no labels/logits
training.fine_tune: exploratory separate train-only labeled adaptation for compiled mirror vs non-Mirror, 200 AdamW updates LR 0.001, same mini-batch sampler; fixed before fresh

development.selection: for each m choose K,R maximizing mean dev accuracy across two dev worlds; tie-break min dev NLL then lower K*R

fresh.K_R: development-frozen selected per m, plus fixed K=1 R=1 diagnostic
fresh.metrics: accuracy, NLL, weight RMSE, logits RMSE, serialized bytes, readout forward wall median, LBFGS elapsed, physical/virtual scalars, MAC proxy

controls: native FP32 weights storage, FP64 replay
native FP16 weights storage, FP64 replay
same-m teacher-selected plain orthogonal sparse basis with LBFGS
low-rank SVD of first layer with all other parameters exact, rank chosen by actual byte cap of Mirror serialized state

gates.retention: mean Mirror test accuracy within 2 percentage points of native in >=2 of 3 worlds
gates.mirror_specific: Mirror exceeds strongest non-Mirror control that fits Mirror inference payload bytes by >=1 percentage point in >=2 of 3 worlds
gates.storage: actual serialized inference bytes incl coefficients, addresses and per-model metadata; report program source separately; if full bytes >= native no end-to-end compression claim
gates.runtime: no speed claims unless measured end-to-end incl decoder; optimized kernel not available

caveats: Only 1797 images, fresh splits share same dataset (not independent domains)
No GPU/VRAM throughput claim from CPU FP64 eager measurements
Quantized controls preserve semantics by casting stored FP16/FP32 to FP64 for CPU comparison, not native low precision runtime
SVD rank comparison uses complete saved factors, even when rank+full second layer exhausts budget
No reported CI with only 3 worlds, repeated splits correlate
K x R expensive Mirror runtime remains payable
